"A tiger needs space – often many square kilometres of forest – to hunt, to roam and to raise its young. In a zoo enclosure, however large it seems to visitors, it can walk from one end to the other in seconds. Experts say that the pacing seen in many caged big cats is a sign of stress. Answer the following:
